Page Indexing was updated 2026-09-14: 515 indexed and 729 excluded. The 217 robots exclusions were catalog category query URLs; the one 4xx was the POST-only /api/inquiry/ endpoint; the one soft 404 was a historic ?q={search_term_string} URL already covered by robots rules. The discovered and crawled-not-indexed samples were localized canonical pages, not the inspected core English pages.
